7.2.0.en:
* Repeated push notifications from Ring are ignored now: Events.doorbell and Events.motion no longer flap after a single event, and no additional snapshots or recordings are taken
* The adapter really starts now when the image library sharp cannot be loaded (7.1.0 still crashed); snapshots then get no text overlay and HD snapshots are not sharpened
* Livestreams without text overlay are no longer re-encoded, which saves a lot of CPU and avoids artifacts on weak systems
* Auto save: "1 hour" did not work and "1 day" ran every minute. The former "1 day" option is shown as "12 hours" now, "1 day" is a new option
* Old files are deleted now also when the ioBroker files are stored in Redis
* locationMode follows the mode of a Ring Alarm system
* Cameras with two batteries get Info.second_battery_percentage and Info.second_battery_percentage_category
* Dependencies have been updated

* Livestreams ohne Textüberlagerung werden nicht mehr neu kodiert - das spart viel CPU und vermeidet Bildfehler auf schwachen Systemen

* locationMode folgt dem Modus einer Ring-Alarmanlage

* Abhängigkeiten wurden aktualisiert

7.0.1.en:
**BREAKING:** enhanced security (added encryption) requires that you enter the access refreshtoken one more time 
The admin tab was rewritten in React (`src-tab/`), replacing the materialize page - doorbell cameras are listed now, they were silently skipped before
The tab no longer assumes the web adapter runs on port 8082; it derives host, port and protocol from the URL states
The adapter was refactored: TypeScript 6, @iobroker/eslint-config, gulp removed
**BREAKING:** `build/` is no longer committed and `common.nogit` is set - the adapter can only be installed from npm, no longer directly from GitHub
`ring-client-api` is ESM only and is loaded dynamically now, which fixes `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM` on Node.js 22.0 - 22.11
All backend timers are managed by js-controller now and are stopped when the instance unloads
Scheduled jobs (daily sun calculation, auto save) are cancelled on unload and no longer collide between instances
Fixed: the health state was never refreshed after switching a camera light
